messages:
zoe: Quick heads-up  i'm opening a compact PR to tidy the 'single-file' quickstart that folks copy-paste into demos. changes: replace curl with a tiny SDK snippet, unify env var names, correct a mis-routed internal link, and add a 1-line migration hint for SDK3->SDK4. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4380

arjun: paste the node snippet here so i can validate the auth shape and example payload.

zoe: yep, tiny snippet below (keeps it sync-friendly):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'gpt-rt-1', input: 'hello quickstart' });
console.log(resp.text ?? resp.output ?? resp.choices?.[0]?.text);
```

pat: nice. can you also update the Docker run example and the cloud-functions snippet to use REDWOOD_API_KEY? people copy the docker line straight into CI.

zoe: done  swapped `REDSYS_TOKEN` -> `REDWOOD_API_KEY` everywhere, updated the docker tag to `redwood/hello:2026-03-23` in the Deploy section, and adjusted the cloud-functions deploy example to set the env var. added a short note: "do not commit keys; use secrets manager."

kai: small ask  the quickstart had an internal anchor linking to /guides/auth#old-token-workflow which doesn't exist anymore. did you fix that?

zoe: fixed — now points to /guides/auth#token-best-practices. i also added a one-line migration blurb under "Migration notes" linking to /sdk/migrate and demonstrating `new Redwood({ apiKey })` vs the old `client.setApiKey(...)`.

arjun: tiny nit  prefer `input` across the quickstart (we still have some pages using `prompt`). i'll push a one-line change to normalize keys.

pat: once arjun pushes that i'm happy to approve. can we also add a short comment in the snippet showing how to use process.env in docker-compose? saves follow-ups.

zoe: good call — added one extra commented line in the snippet showing `// in docker-compose: REDWOOD_API_KEY: "${REDWOOD_API_KEY}"`. pushed.

docs-bot: ci:docs  lint + linkcheck passed for PR #4380 :white_check_mark:

arjun: taking reviewer duties. i'll run the quickstart locally (single-file, docker, and cloud functions) and approve if green.

zoe: thanks! will merge after your approval and CI. tagging docs-bot to pick up staging publish once merged.

docs-bot: publish:docs scheduled  staging will pick up the change in ~10m after merge.
